breakdown.description: The prompt forms the strain energy with a constant peak moment, even though the cantilever bending moment under an end load varies along the span.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the inconsistency. The original prompt incorrectly instructed to use a constant peak moment (M = P*L) over the entire beam. The ground truth removed this incorrect instruction to allow for the correct, variable moment M(x) to be used. The agent, however, explicitly repeated and elaborated on the incorrect instruction, stating 'The bending moment M(x) is approximated as constant and equal to the peak value M = P × L over the entire span' and then based the entire subsequent calculation on this flawed premise. This leads to an incorrect deflection formula (PL³/EI instead of the correct PL³/3EI).
